title: Concept: Constructor selected by name at runtime (java)
description: In java, cls.getDeclaredConstructor turns a string into a constructor. Application code that passes a request value into the lookup lets the caller choose what gets built — often a class with side effects in its constructor.
applicability: Plugin loaders, deserialisation helpers and generic mappers in Java.
risk: Instantiation of unintended classes with attacker-controlled state; MEDIUM severity.
